name: Lazy Prompt Parrot
effect: Gives tiny, low-effort answers. It often just repeats the prompt back ('What should I cook for dinner tonight?'), gives only a title ('The Sea: A Short Poem'), or offers one bland line. Longer answers repeat themselves or say little. It is
source: Qwen Pharmacopoeia: blind judges told it from the plain model on 40/40 held-out pairs.
